reply_text:
Now a test that replays the exact cycle (stop, failed review, stop again) and checks the row ends up waiting for the owner.The topology loop can no longer cycle that way, and the two analysis problems will keep running past their attempt cap. The topology loops are still stopped; restarting them is your call given Codex usage.

**Topology loop repair** (pushed to apm-lean master):
- **The cause:** an author "stop" was recorded as "awaiting review", a failed review sent the row back to the same author, and nothing counted the rounds.
- **The fix:** the transition step now counts per row. A row that stops twice, or fails review four times, is set to "needs owner", which the loop neither reviews nor schedules again. Both limits are environment settings.
- **Tested:** I added a test that replays stop, failed review, stop, and checks the row ends up waiting for the owner. With the limit switched off that test fails, and with it on the whole loop test suite passes.
- **The two stuck rows:** I parked both as "needs owner", with the repair each seat had asked for written into the row. I did not make those repairs myself, so t98a06 part (a) and the t94a08 affine-chart row will wait for an owner decision.
- **What would run next:** both worklists have other runnable rows — a t98j01 circle-reflection row on topo1 and a t97a04 covering-homology row on topo2.

**Analysis problems:**
- The build loop is still running m02J02 (attempt 42 or so) and m96J03 (attempt 22).
- Each problem has a follow-on unit waiting (`solve-cont-m02J02`, `solve-cont-m96J03`). When the build loop drops a problem at its 50-attempt cap, the unit starts a fresh run on the same seat with 60 more attempts and 6 strategy passes. If the problem lands first, the unit exits without doing anything.
- The other 10 open analysis problems are not running. solve-3 is idle and could take them; I left that alone because of usage.

All earlier commits are pushed too, including the three new proofs.

Should I restart the two topology loops now?
